content:
Ari: Throwing this out there  "Analog Arcade Showdown" next Wednesday? CRT projector + 4-player couch setup + a tiny pinball cabinet I can roll in. :joystick:
Ken: Ooh love. Will this be tournament style or casual freeplay?
Ari: Mostly freeplay with a couple quick tourneys (best of 3) for Smash and a 1v1 pinball high-score challenge. Sign up on the whiteboard when you arrive.
Zoe: Can someone bring a GameCube adapter and a couple GC controllers? I can bring my Switch Pro and cables.
Rahul: Ill bring two wired Xbox pads and a power strip. Also happy to manage the bracket if we do it.
Maddy: I can handle snacks  chips + vegan dip + a small candy stash. Any allergies I should know about?
Ken: Please avoid peanuts (allergic).
Ari: Noted. Also plan: projector mirror so remote folks can watch the stream in #random. Maddy, do you mind if we run a small pay-what-you-want snack fund jar? :coin:
Maddy: Fine by me. Ill print a tiny sign.
Ken: Logistics q: does the mezz have space for the pinball? Its ~2ft deep with legs.
Ari: Itll tuck by the pillar next to the couch. Ill bring a dolly.
Rahul: For tournament rules: Smash 3-stock, items off, Omega stage pool. Pinball: single ball, 3 minutes. Cool?
Zoe: Sounds fair. Also can we do a goofy "high score remix" rule for the last round where everyone uses left-hand-only controllers? :joy:
Ari: Love it. Left-hand-only round is on the docket as a meme final if time allows.
event-bot: Event created: "Analog Arcade Showdown" Wed 19:00  mezzanine. RSVP: https://calendar.company/e/analog-arcade-showdown
Rahul: Ill make a quick Google Sheet for brackets + running scores. Posting here shortly.
Maddy: If anyone wants to bring a small LED lamp for ambience, yes please. Also bring chargers.
Ken: Count me in. Bringing extra thumb grips and canned coffee. :thumbsup:
